question: Should Full Release Validation treat the existing explicitly tracked, structural Codex harness-gap classification as an approved advisory result for release gating?
rationale: This is a release-policy decision: the implementation is deliberately changing what evidence can satisfy a trusted release validator, rather than only correcting an internal implementation detail.

options.title: Accept the bounded advisory exception
options.body: Merge after an after-fix release-validation run proves the exact classifier-approved shape passes and invalid gap shapes still fail.

options.title: Keep literal dual-pass gating
options.body: Reject the exception and require the runtime-pair classifier or harness to report literal passes before release validation can succeed.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded advisory exception
recommendation.body: Merge after an after-fix release-validation run proves the exact classifier-approved shape passes and invalid gap shapes still fail.

likelyOwner.reason: The current change and its stated release-validation evidence are authored and owned in this review context by steipete.
